rows.text: You are in a pitch-black room. The television before you is showing an infomercial channel funded by the IPC Traditional Project Department.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "You're watching the Capital of Passion infomercial channel. Before we start, we'd like to respond to the complaints on the Casket of Inaccuracy lodged by our viewers. As you know, if the Casket of Inaccuracy is accurate, it should be called the 'Casket of Accuracy' instead... *crackle*..."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Static appears on the old television as the signals get weaker. Soon, you cannot even hear the sound clearly.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Next, we'd like to introduce a pan-cosmic product from IPC."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "A box of expired doughnuts. As the Capital of Passion has entered its 4th era, food can almost be preserved forever. Thus, the citizens are curious about how expired food tastes."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "A lotus that can sing the Happy Birthday song. As a feature in everyone's childhood, it appears countless times in people's dreams."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "A mechanical box. It looks like it didn't manage to get sold for over 200 years."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You take a bite of the doughnut and feel your stomach churning...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As the lotus starts singing, your childhood memories come flooding back. You seem to have traveled back in time to the previous era...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You open the box and see something odd inside...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The infomercial is addictive. You want to keep watching, but the screen suddenly turns off.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
